caption: A skilled individual is honing their sword fighting skills.
As the person adjusts their stance, they extend one arm outwards and rotate their body slightly to the side.
The man is doing A Monster  Powers Up. A person is crouched low, poised for a powerful jump.
The man is doing A Naughty Boy Walking Motion. He walks with a playful stride, his arms swinging freely beside him.
The man is doing Passing through gaps. They stretch with a flowing motion, reaching up with one arm and back with the other.
The individual assumes a wide stance and extends their arms before retracting them while leaning forward, exuding a calm demeanor.
A man wielding a katana executes dynamic sword techniques.
A person executes a drop kick by jumping, extending their legs to strike, and landing with focus.

The man is doing Bizarre soldier. A warrior assumes a combat-ready position, drawing a sword from their back while crouching slightly, before swinging it forward in a powerful arc, their body twisting for added momentum, and then returning to the starting stance with precision and strength.
The man is doing Long stick stance. A person maintains balance with a steady stance, using a long stick for support, before shifting weight and rotating their body.
